notes.content: Thank you for your interest in Sacramento State! This articulation agreement displays the lower-division courses required in the major: Sacramento State courses on the left and approved (articulated) transfer courses on the right. Although completion of the coursework listed below is not mandatory prior to admission, students are advised to complete as much lower-division course preparation as possible prior to transfer. Thank you for your interest in Sacramento State!


This articulation agreement displays the lower-division courses required in the major: Sacramento State courses on the left and approved (articulated) transfer courses on the right. Although completion of the coursework listed below is not mandatory prior to admission, students are advised to complete as much lower-division course preparation as possible prior to transfer.


Additional Resources:

  • See the University Catalog for the full listing of degree requirements for this major.
  • Visit our Sac State Apply page for more information about our campus!
  • Visit the Admissions website for current transfer admission requirements.
  • Connect with an Admissions Counselor.

notes.content: Students must earn a "C-" grade or higher in all courses required in the major. In addition to applying for admission to Sac State, all undergraduate applicants must complete an entrance audition. For additional information on suggested repertoire and audition dates, please visit: School of Music Admissions . Students who are selected for admission to the music major must take the theory, musicianship, and piano placement exams prior to initial enrollment. The theory and musicianship placement exams may be taken only once. For additional information, please visit: Theory and Piano Placement exams . Entrance to the Single Subject Teaching Credential in the Music Program requires demonstration of proficiency through intensive interviews which include proficiency exams on all instruments and voice. For additional information, please visit: School of Music .
notes.contentHtml:
1. Students must earn a "C-" grade or higher in all courses required in the major.
  2. In addition to applying for admission to Sac State, all undergraduate applicants must complete an entrance audition. For additional information on suggested repertoire and audition dates, please visit: School of Music Admissions.
  3. Students who are selected for admission to the music major must take the theory, musicianship, and piano placement exams prior to initial enrollment. The theory and musicianship placement exams may be taken only once. For additional information, please visit: Theory and Piano Placement exams.
  4. Entrance to the Single Subject Teaching Credential in the Music Program requires demonstration of proficiency through intensive interviews which include proficiency exams on all instruments and voice.
  5. For additional information, please visit: School of Music.
